$comment: 语法大厅 G12（V0.9 P1b）。比喻与 KET 八课 L2 字面一致：do/does/did 是指挥的起拍手势——自己没有意思，只负责举手宣布问句（或否定句）。全部内容原创。
title: 疑问句与助动词 do
metaphor: do 是指挥的起拍手势，不发声但全团知道要开始
ketNote: Does she likes 类错误是 KET 写作最扎眼的伤；Part 5 与听力问答全靠这套结构。八课里的亲戚是 L2。

sections.essence: do 是指挥的起拍手势——自己没有意思，只负责宣布：问句（或否定）开始。
sections.why: 中文提问最省事：句尾加个「吗」，其他一个字不动——「你喜欢音乐吗？」所以中国孩子最自然的英语问句是 You like music?——这不算瞎错，四百年前的英国人真这么说（那时把动词搬到句首提问）。后来英语改了规矩：实义动词不许挪窝，句首的位置交给一位专职举手的——do。它自己没有任何意思，只负责宣布「这是问句（或否定句）」，顺便替主动词报了时态和人称：轮到她是 does，说昨天是 did。手势既然报了，后面的动词就永远站回原形——一支乐队，只需要一个人打拍子。
sections.metaphorStory: 开演前，指挥不出声，只把手一抬——全团立刻知道：要开始了。do 就是这只手。Do you like music? 里的 do 没有词义，它只是举在句首的手势，宣布「问句开始」。轮到问「她」，手势换成 does——手势替她报了三单，所以后面的 like 不用再加 s；问昨天的事，手势换成 did——手势报了过去，动词也站回原形。一支乐队只需要一个人打拍子，谁都抢拍就乱了（Does she likes ✗）。还有两位自带指挥棒的成员不请 do：be 动词和情态动词（can/must），它们自己搬到句首就能提问——Is she...? Can you...?

cards.rule: 一般疑问句：Do / Does / Did + 主语 + 原形
cards.detail: 现在用 Do（三单 Does），过去一律 Did——手势报时报人称。
cards.example: Do you swim? / Does she sing? / Did they win?

cards.rule: 否定句：don't / doesn't / didn't + 原形
cards.detail: 否定手势也替动词报了时态人称。
cards.example: I don't know. / He doesn't like fish. / We didn't go.

cards.rule: 手势举过，动词永远原形
cards.detail: 「一队只一个打拍子」——Does she likes、Did you went 都是两个人抢拍。
cards.example: Does she like music?（like 不加 s）

cards.rule: be 和情态动词自带指挥棒
cards.detail: 它们不请 do：自己搬到句首提问、自己加 not 否定。
cards.example: Are you ready? / Can she swim? / He isn't here.

cards.rule: 特殊疑问句：疑问词 + 手势 + 主语 + 原形
cards.detail: What / Where / When / Who / How 站最前，后面照旧。
cards.example: What do you like? / Where does he live?

cards.detail: 用什么手势问，就用什么手势答。
cards.example: — Do you like it? — Yes, I do. / — Did she come? — No, she didn't.

basic.en: Does your sister play the flute?
Did you watch the show last night?
— Do you swim? — Yes, I do.

mid.en: What do you usually do on Sundays?
mid.cn: 你周日一般做什么？（第二个 do 是实义动词「做」）

mid.en: She doesn't eat ice cream in winter.
They didn't go to the rehearsal yesterday.
How do you go to school every day?

trap.en: Does she like music? — like 保持原形。
trap.note: does 已经替她报了三单——like 再加 s 就是两个人抢拍。

trap.en: Did you see the film? — see 保持原形。
trap.note: did 已经报了过去——动词回到原形，不说 Did you saw。

trap.en: Are you happy? — be 的句子不请 do。
trap.note: be 自带指挥棒，自己搬句首——不说 Do you are happy。

trap.en: Can you swim? — 情态动词也不请 do。
trap.note: can 和 be 一样自带指挥棒——不说 Do you can swim。

trap.en: What does your father do? — 两个 do 各干各的。
trap.cn: 你爸爸是做什么工作的？
trap.note: 前一个 does 是手势，后一个 do 是实义动词「做」——问职业的固定句。

trap.en: — Don't you like it? — No, I don't.（不喜欢就答 No）
trap.note: 英语的 Yes/No 只看事实：不喜欢永远答 No——别按中文的「对/不对」回答。

redBlack.why: 双重否定打架——到底有没有钱？听的人猜不出。否定句里的「一些」用 any。

redBlack.bad: — Don't you like it? — Yes.（想说：对，我不喜欢）
redBlack.good: — Don't you like it? — No, I don't.
redBlack.why: 英语的 Yes 永远=喜欢、No 永远=不喜欢——按中文「对呀」答 Yes，意思正好说反。
does 已报三单，like 再加 s 就是两个人抢拍——手势后动词回原形。
光靠语调提问是四百年前的老规矩——现在问句要请 do 举手。
三单的否定手势是 doesn't。

redBlack.bad: Did you went to the park?
redBlack.good: Did you go to the park?
redBlack.why: did 已报过去，went 再变就是抢拍——回原形 go。
can 自带指挥棒，自己加 not——轮不到 don't。
be 的句子 be 自己搬句首——不请 do。

redBlack.good: What do you like for breakfast?
redBlack.why: 疑问词后面还是要有手势——What do you...?
does 举手后 live 回原形。

redBlack.bad: Whom do you like best in the band?
redBlack.good: Who do you like best in the band?
redBlack.why: whom 是老派书面语，日常和 KET 里说 who 没人扣分。

redBlack.bad: Do you know where is the station?
redBlack.good: Do you know where the station is?
redBlack.why: 句子套句子时里层不再倒装——说错了意思照样通，KET 也很少考这么深。

contrast.cn: 你喜欢音乐吗？（句尾加「吗」）
contrast.en: Do you like music?（句首举 do）
contrast.diff: 中文在句尾贴标签；英语在句首举手势——位置相反，功能相同。

contrast.en: She doesn't eat fish.（请 doesn't + 原形）
contrast.diff: 中文的「不」直接贴动词；英语要先请手势，动词退回原形。

contrast.en: Do / Does / Did 看人称和时态换
contrast.diff: 中文的问号标签不变形；英语的手势替动词报时报人称。

contrast.en: — Don't you like it? — No, I don't.
contrast.diff: 中文的「对」应和对方说法；英语的 Yes/No 只看事实——不喜欢就 No。

contrast.en: Can you swim?（can 自己搬家）
contrast.diff: 中文一个「吗」通吃；英语分两队——be/情态自带指挥棒，其余请 do。

quickJudge.mnemonic: 先看动词：be 和 can 自己搬家；其余请 do 举手，动词回原形
steps: 想提问或否定？先看句子里的动词是谁。
是 be（am/is/are/was/were）或情态动词（can/must）→ 它自己搬句首 / 自己加 not，不请 do。
是普通动词 → 请手势：现在 Do（三单 Does）、过去 Did；否定 don't / doesn't / didn't。
手势举过，主动词一律回原形——检查有没有两个人抢拍（Does...likes ✗）。
简答跟手势走：Do 问 do 答；回答 Yes/No 只看事实，别按中文的「对/不对」。

parentScript.script: 「宝贝，英语提问要请一位不说话的指挥：他叫 do，往句子最前面一站、手一举，大家就知道这是问句。他还很贴心——他举了手，后面的动词就什么都不用变了。咱们玩举手游戏：我用中文问你问题（『你喜欢冰激凌吗？』『爸爸昨天加班了吗？』），你先说该派哪位指挥出场——问现在派 Do，问『他/她』派 Does，问昨天派 Did——再把问句说完整。」不用懂英语，记住口诀帮她检查：指挥举了手，动词就不许再变形——听到她说 Does she likes 就喊「抢拍啦」。
questions: 中文的「吗」在句尾，英语的 do 在哪里？它自己有意思吗？
Does she like music? 里的 like 为什么不加 s？
「你是学生吗？」这句要请 do 吗？为什么？

sections.echo: do 这套手势是英语四百年前的新发明。莎士比亚的年代两种问法并行：他既写 Like you music?（动词自己搬家的老规矩），也写 Do you like music?（新式手势）。后来新规矩赢了，但有两族词守住了老特权：be 和情态动词，至今还能自己搬到句首。为什么偏偏是它们？因为它们是全语言最常用的动词——天天被搬来搬去，习惯焊死了，新规矩管不着。越常用的词，越保得住老规矩：这是基石层暗线最后一次亮相，往后你在每一层还会遇见它。

stages.name: 认一认 · 派哪只手势

questions.q: 问「你」现在的爱好，派谁举手？
questions.explain: you + 现在——Do you...?

questions.q: 问「她」现在的习惯，派谁举手？
questions.explain: 三单的她——Does。

questions.q: 问「昨天」的事，派谁举手？
questions.explain: 过去一律 Did，不分人称。

questions.q: 问「他」现在的情况，派谁举手？
questions.explain: 三单的他——Does。

questions.q: 问「他们」现在的事，派谁举手？
questions.explain: they 复数——Do。

questions.q: 问「你妈妈」的工作，派谁举手？
questions.explain: your mother 三单——Does。

questions.q: 问「你和汤姆」的事，派谁举手？
questions.explain: you and Tom 两个人——Do。

questions.q: 「他不喜欢」：He ___ like...
questions.explain: 三单现在的否定——doesn't。

questions.q: 「我们不知道」：We ___ know.
questions.explain: we + 现在——don't。

questions.q: 「昨天没去」：They ___ go yesterday.
questions.explain: 过去的否定——didn't。

questions.q: 「我不知道」：I ___ know.
questions.explain: I + 现在——don't。

questions.q: 「她不吃鱼」：She ___ eat fish.
questions.explain: 三单否定——doesn't；eat 保持原形。

questions.q: Did 举手之后，动词用什么形？
questions.explain: 手势已报过去——动词回原形。

questions.q: Does 举手之后，动词要加 s 吗？
questions.explain: does 已替她报了三单——动词不再加 s。

questions.q: 「你是学生吗？」要请 do 吗？
questions.explain: be 自带指挥棒——Are you a student?

questions.q: 「你会游泳吗？」要请 do 吗？
questions.explain: 情态动词自带指挥棒——Can you swim?

questions.q: ___ you like this song?
questions.explain: you + 实义动词 like——Do。

questions.q: ___ your sister play the flute?
questions.explain: your sister 三单——Does。

questions.q: ___ they go to the concert yesterday?
questions.explain: yesterday——Did。

questions.q: He ___ like coffee at all.
questions.explain: 三单否定 doesn't。

questions.q: I ___ watch TV last night.
questions.explain: last night——didn't。

questions.q: What ___ you usually do on Sundays?
questions.explain: 疑问词后照举手势——What do you...?

questions.q: Where ___ your uncle live?
questions.explain: your uncle 三单——does；live 回原形。

questions.q: — Do you like ice cream? — Yes, I ___.
questions.explain: Do 问 do 答——Yes, I do。

questions.q: — Does Tom swim well? — No, he ___.
questions.explain: Does 问 doesn't 答。

questions.q: — Did you see the film? — Yes, I ___.
questions.explain: Did 问 did 答。

questions.q: When ___ the concert start tonight?
questions.explain: the concert 三单——does。

questions.q: My parents ___ work on Saturdays.
questions.explain: parents 复数——don't。

questions.q: ___ it rain a lot in your city?
questions.explain: it 三单——Does it rain...?

questions.q: How ___ you go to school every day?
questions.explain: you——do。

questions.q: She ___ finish her homework yesterday.
questions.explain: yesterday——didn't；finish 回原形。

questions.q: Why ___ he look so happy today?
questions.explain: he 三单——does；look 回原形。

questions.q: 哪一句没抢拍？（她喜欢冰激凌吗）
questions.explain: does 举手后 like 回原形——一队只一个打拍子。

questions.q: 哪一句是健康的问句？（你喜欢这首歌吗）
questions.explain: 现代英语问句要请 do 举手——光靠语调是四百年前的说法。

questions.q: 哪一句的否定是健康的？（他不做作业）
questions.explain: 三单否定 doesn't；第二个 do 是实义动词。

questions.q: 哪一句没抢拍？（你昨天看电影了吗）
options: Did you see the film yesterday?
Did you saw the film yesterday?
Do you saw the film yesterday?
questions.explain: did 已报过去——see 回原形。

questions.q: 哪一句是健康的？（我不会游泳）
questions.explain: can 自带指挥棒，自己加 not。

questions.q: 哪一句是健康的问句？（你开心吗）
questions.explain: be 的句子 be 自己搬家——不请 do。

questions.q: 哪一句是健康的问句？（你早饭吃什么）
options: What do you have for breakfast?
questions.explain: 疑问词后面还是要举手势——What do you...?

questions.q: 哪一句没抢拍？（他住在哪）
questions.explain: does + 原形 live。

questions.q: 哪一句的简答是健康的？（——你打网球吗？——打）
questions.explain: Do 问 do 答。

questions.q: 哪一句是健康的？（她昨天没来排练）
options: She didn't come to the rehearsal yesterday.
She didn't came to the rehearsal yesterday.
She doesn't came to the rehearsal yesterday.
questions.explain: didn't + 原形 come。

questions.q: 哪一句是健康的问句？（他是你哥哥吗）
questions.explain: 没有实义动词——be 自己上。

questions.q: 哪一句是健康的问句？（你能帮我吗）
questions.explain: can 自己搬句首，后接原形。

questions.q: 哪一句是健康的？（他不喜欢蔬菜）
questions.explain: doesn't + 原形 like——别抢拍。

questions.q: 哪一句是健康的问句？（谁是你们的指挥）
questions.explain: 问「是谁」用 be——Who is...?

questions.q: 哪一句是健康的问句？（你爸爸做什么工作）
questions.explain: 前一个 does 是手势，后一个 do 是实义动词「做」。

questions.q: 哪一句是健康的？（她不吃早饭吗？）
questions.explain: 否定疑问：Doesn't + 主语 + 原形。

questions.q: ___ your brother a doctor?
questions.explain: 没有实义动词，「是」医生——be 自己上。

questions.q: ___ your brother work in a hospital?
questions.explain: 有实义动词 work——请 Does。上一题的孪生兄弟，看动词选指挥。

questions.q: — ___ you at home last night? — No, I ___ at the concert.
questions.explain: 「在家」没有实义动词——用 be 的过去 were/was。

questions.q: — ___ you go anywhere last night? — Yes, I ___ to the concert.
questions.explain: 问句 did + go 原形；答句是陈述句，went 自己报过去。

questions.q: She ___ to the party because she ___ well.
questions.explain: 两个 didn't 后都跟原形——go、feel。

questions.q: — Don't you like this song? — ___（其实很喜欢）
questions.explain: 喜欢就答 Yes, I do——Yes/No 只看事实，不看问法。

questions.q: I don't have ___ money with me today.
questions.explain: 否定句里的「一些」用 any——don't + no 是双重否定打架。

questions.q: How often ___ your band practise?
questions.explain: band 当整体三单——does；practise 回原形。

questions.q: What time ___ the museum open on Sundays?
questions.explain: the museum 三单——does。

questions.q: — ___ Lily and Lucy come from Beijing? — Yes, they ___.
questions.explain: 两个人复数——Do 问 do 答。

questions.q: Why ___ you tell me earlier? I missed the show!
questions.explain: 埋怨过去没说——didn't tell。

questions.q: — What ___ your mother ___ ? — She's a nurse.
questions.explain: 问职业固定句：What does she do? 手势 does + 实义 do。

questions.q: ___ there a rehearsal today, or ___ we have a day off?
questions.explain: There be 问句用 Is there；后半句实义动词 have——do。

questions.q: He ___ the drum now — he ___ it every evening.
questions.explain: 此刻的否定跟 be（G07）；习惯用常态牌 plays（G06）。

questions.q: — ___ she ___ her homework yet? 哦不对，用过去问：___ she finish it last night?
questions.explain: last night 的完成与否——Did she finish...?（did + 原形）。

questions.q: 大考：___ you like music? ___ your sister like it too? ___ you both go to the concert last week?
questions.explain: you 现在 Do；三单 Does；上周 Did——三只手势一次点齐。

detective.clue: does 已经替她报了三单——like 再加 s 就是抢拍。
现代英语的问句要请 do 到句首举手——光靠语调是老古董问法。

detective.sentence: He don't do his homework every day.
detective.fixed: He doesn't do his homework every day.
detective.clue: 三单的否定手势是 doesn't——第二个 do 是实义动词，不用动。

detective.sentence: Did you saw the film last night?
detective.fixed: Did you see the film last night?
detective.clue: did 已经报了过去——saw 要退回原形 see。
does 举手后动词回原形——lives 的 s 是抢来的拍。

detective.sentence: I didn't went to school yesterday.
detective.fixed: I didn't go to school yesterday.
detective.clue: didn't 已报过去——went 退回原形 go。

detective.sentence: Do he play the drum in your band?
detective.fixed: Does he play the drum in your band?
detective.clue: he 是三单——手势要换成 Does。
